# Thalles Maia

> Software Developer building accessible, fast, and enjoyable web experiences since 2008 — from Brazil to London.

## About

Thalles Maia has been working in software development since 2008. He started out
building websites for small companies in Brazil, and now works on large-scale systems
in London. Whether the project is big or small, his goal is always the same: to build
web experiences that are fast, accessible, and genuinely enjoyable for people to use.

## Experience

- Senior Software Engineer, Booking.com — London, UK (Aug 2022 – present)
- Senior Front-end Developer, Bally's Interactive — London, UK (Aug 2019 – Aug 2022)
- Front-end Developer, Minu — Belo Horizonte, Brazil (Nov 2018 – May 2019)
- Full-stack Developer, JMV Technology — Divinópolis, Brazil (Nov 2012 – Nov 2018)
- Full-stack Developer, MB Soluções Digitais — São Gonçalo do Pará, Brazil (Jun 2008 – Oct 2012)

## Projects

- Secret Santa (https://secret-santa.thallesmaia.com/): Organize gift exchanges — create events, invite friends, automatic matching.
- Podcastplayer.app (https://podcastplayer.app/en): A personal podcast player for discovering and listening to podcasts.
